title: Buy with your company account
lead: TAMSTAR opens an account for each company, invites a company admin, and the admin adds the procurement team with their roles and purchase limits.

create.title: Account created by TAMSTAR
create.body: Our team opens your company account and assigns a company admin.

invite.title: Admin activates
invite.body: The admin receives an invitation, activates the account and sets up the team.

team.title: Team & limits
team.body: Add buyers, assign permissions and set per-order and monthly purchase limits.

buy.title: Order at contract prices
buy.body: Browse, add to cart and order — prices follow your company agreement.

requestLead: Tell us about your company and our team will contact you to open the account.
signInBody: Online sign-in opens with the launch of company accounts. Until then, request an account or send a quotation request.
checkoutBody: Orders are placed by verified company buyers so that contract prices, purchase limits and e-invoicing apply. Request an account, or send this cart as a quotation request now.
